request.categoryIds: 1..100 unique owned category UUIDs, including each selected child parent

response.token: 256-bit random opaque hex token (returned once; stored as SHA-256)

endpoints.limits: 50 active shares per owner; request <=64KiB; owner and active source epoch checked; Idempotency-Key response receipt encrypted for 24 hours

response.categories: category configuration whitelist: sourceId, direction, parentSourceId, name, iconRef, color, sortOrder, excludeBudget

errors.410: Expired or revoked token, or source dataset epoch changed

endpoints.ownership: Owner only; cross-owner IDs return 404; same key and request digest replay safely

iconRef: Current Android category assets and initialized category rows define no iconRef resource identifiers. This version accepts only null and rejects every non-null value until the product icon contract is established.
privacy: Shares contain category settings only; no user identity, ledger metadata, accounts, transactions, remarks, attachments or credentials.
